subject: general
question: The ratio between the radius of the base and the height of a cylinder is 3: 4. If its volume is 38808 cm³ then, using π = (22)/(7) find the diameter of the cylinder.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **radius (r)** to **height (h)** = 3 : 4 ⇒ Let r = 3x and h = 4x.

Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × (3x)² × 4x = 38808.

⇒ (22/7) × 9x² × 4x = 38808 ⇒ x³ = (38808 × 7) ÷ (22 × 36) = 343.

⇒ x = √³(343) = 7.

**Diameter** = 2r = 2 × 3x = 6 × 7 = 42 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05a8cbfef6b76bdf6044f48d9cac1a254dc4002ceefaefac20e4fee5706c503b.png] 

**Given:** Ratio r : h = 3 : 4, Volume (V) = 38808 cm³, π = 22/7.

**Formula Used:** Volume of Cylinder = πr²h; Diameter = 2r.

⇒ Let r = 3x and h = 4x.

⇒ 38808 = (22/7) × (3x)² × 4x

⇒ 38808 = (22/7) × 9x² × 4x

⇒ 38808 = (22 × 36 × x³) / 7

⇒ x³ = (38808 × 7) / 792

⇒ x³ = 49 × 7 = 343

⇒ x = 7

⇒ Radius (r) = 3 × 7 = 21 cm

⇒ Diameter = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h).

Volume Ratios

If dimensions are scaled by factor k, area scales by k² and volume scales by k³.

Diameter Relation

The diameter is always twice the radius (d = 2r) in any circular cross-section solid.</p
